summary: Star Micronics is a major global POS hardware provider (receipt/kitchen printers, labeling, cash management, customer-engagement devices) with over one million Star devices operating globally; its printers are supported by major ordering/POS platforms including DoorDash, Grubhub, Shopify, Square, and Uber Eats.

Star Micronics showcased labeling, order-accuracy, and cloud-POS-integrated hardware solutions at the 2026 National Restaurant Show (May 16-19, 2026, Chicago), with Global Director of Business Development Christophe Naasz representing the company. (Scope note: Source date approximated to the show timeframe (May 2026); exact blog publish date not independently confirmed.)
